# has conductor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasConductor`](gmeow-hasConductor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasConductor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a creative work or expression to the agent who conducted its musical performance. Flat shortcut subproperty of [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

Use [`gmeow:hasConductor`](gmeow-hasConductor.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of naming a conductor; typically attaches at the performed [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) or its [`Recording`](../classes/gmeow-Recording.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the credit's period, degree, or evidence must be first-class (promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) with [`gmeow:roleConductor`](../individuals/gmeow-roleConductor.md)) and avoid it for instrumental performers ([`gmeow:hasPerformer`](gmeow-hasPerformer.md)).

### How to use

- Assert from the performed [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) or [`Recording`](../classes/gmeow-Recording.md) to the agent; promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) carrying [`gmeow:roleConductor`](../individuals/gmeow-roleConductor.md) when metadata is needed.

- ex:eroica1963 [`gmeow:hasConductor`](gmeow-hasConductor.md) ex:karajan.
